items.title: 7.4 Stationary waves aur un ki banawat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4 with Fig. 7.6 (PDF 146-147).

blocks.text: Stationary waves, jinhein standing waves bhi kehte hain, woh waves hain jo aage barhe ya phaile baghair ek muqarrar jagah par oscillate karti (hilti) hain. Yeh do aisi waves ki superposition se banti hain jin ki frequency aur amplitude barabar ho aur jo ulti simton mein chal rahi hon. Is se banne wala pattern thehra rehta hai: nodes (zero amplitude wale points) aur antinodes (zyada se zyada amplitude wale points) apni jagah par fixed rehte hain. Misalein: string (taar) par waves aur pipe mein sound waves. "Standing wave" ka lafz batata hai ke pattern jagah mein thehra rehta hai, positive aur negative values ke darmiyan hilta hai, aage ya peeche nahi chalta.

Ab ek string par ulti simton mein chalti do waves ki superposition dekhein. Figures 7.6 (a) aur (b) in do waves ki shakal (profile) waqt t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3/4 T aur T par dikhate hain; T wave ka time period hai. Hum in lamhon par points 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 aur 7 ka displacement maloom karna chahte hain jab dono waves superpose hoti hain. Yeh points ek doosre se λ/4 door hain, jahan λ wavelength hai. Superposition ke principle se in points ka resultant displacement nikal sakte hain.

Figure 7.6 (c) points 1, 3, 5 aur 7 ka resultant displacement t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T par dikhati hai. In points ka resultant displacement hamesha zero rehta hai. Medium ke in points ko nodes kehte hain. Do lagataar nodes ka faasla λ/2 hai.

blocks.alt: t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T ke paanch kalam. Qatar (a): baen chalti magenta lehar (teer), qatar (b): daen chalti magenta lehar (teer), nuqte 1 se 7 tak dashed lakeeron par, chauthai wavelength ke faasle par. Qatar (c): nuqte 1, 3, 5, 7 har lamhe axis par, always at rest. Qatar (d): nuqte 2, 4, 6 displacement ke teeron ke sath, t = 0 aur T par 2, 6 oopar aur 4 neeche, T/2 par ulat, T/4 aur 3T/4 par koi nahi: always oscillating.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.6: Stationary / standing waves (kitab ki Figure 7.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har column mein (a) aur (b) ko jama karein. Points 1, 3, 5, 7 par dono lehrein hamesha ek doosre ko khatam karti hain: yeh nodes hain (always at rest). Points 2, 4, 6 par t = 0 par dono crest hain (double displacement), T/4 par dono ka jor zero, T/2 par dono trough: yeh antinodes hain jo sab se zyada hilte hain (always oscillating).

Figure 7.6 (d) points 2, 4 aur 6 ka resultant displacement inhi lamhon par dikhati hai. Yeh points itne amplitude se hilte hain jo dono waves ke amplitudes ka sum hai (arrows se dikhaya gaya). In points ko antinodes kehte hain. Yeh nodes ke bilkul beech mein hote hain aur aapas mein λ/2 door hain. Node se agle antinode ka faasla λ/4 hai. Nodes aur antinodes ke aise pattern ko stationary ya standing wave kehte hain.

Wave mein energy medium ke particles ki harkat (motion) se aage jati hai. Nodes hamesha aaram (rest) mein rehte hain, is liye energy in points se aage nahi guzar sakti. Is liye energy nodes ke darmiyan medium mein “thehri” (standing) rehti hai, halanke antinodes par yeh potential aur kinetic energy mein badalti rehti hai. Jab saare antinodes apne aakhri (extreme) displacement par hon to jama energy poori potential hoti hai, aur jab woh sab ek saath equilibrium position se guzrein to energy poori kinetic hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya taar par ek hi simt mein chalti do milti julti waves stationary wave bana sakti hain (short question 7.5)? Node aur antinode ki tareef kijiye (MCQ 7.3, 7.4, 7.5).
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Stationary wave ke liye ek hi frequency aur amplitude ki ulti simton mein chalti do waves chahiye, aam taur par ek wave aur us ka reflection; ek hi simt mein do milti julti waves bas mil kar bari chalti hui wave banati hain. Node sifar displacement ka nuqta hai, hamesha aaram mein; antinode zyada se zyada displacement ka nuqta hai, nodes ke beech mein; pattern muqarrar jagah par jhoolta hai.

items: Stationary (standing) wave: barabar frequency aur amplitude wali, ulti simton mein chalti do waves ki superposition; pattern thehra rehta hai.
Nodes: hamesha zero displacement, aapas mein λ/2 door. Antinodes: zyada se zyada displacement, nodes ke beech, node se λ/4.
Energy nodes se aage nahi jati; antinodes par potential aur kinetic mein badalti hai.
